P.name: Goes Where He Pleases
P.title: Template:Data Dr. Mundo/Goes Where He Pleases
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Goes Where He Pleases|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Dr. Mundo
|skill        = I
|icon         = false
|blurbicon    = Goes Where He Pleases.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Dr. Mundo}} {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}}}} an additional portion of {{as|his '''maximum''' health}}.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Passive:}} Periodically, '''Dr. Mundo''' gains immunity to the next hostile {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect to affect him, and upon resisting one, he loses a portion of {{as|his '''current''' health}} and drops a canister nearby.
|blurb3       = '''Dr. Mundo''' and enemy {{tip|champions}} can move near the canister to destroy it. If he destroys the canister, the cooldown is {{sti|cdr|reduced}} and he will {{tip|heal}} for a portion of {{as|his '''maximum''' health}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}}}} an additional{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|0.4; then +0.05*x for 5; then +0.1*x for 6; then +0.15*x for 3; then +0.2*x|formula=0.4% + 0.05% per level at level 1, then + 0.1% per level starting at level 7, then + 0.15% per level starting at level 13, then + 0.2% per level starting at level 16|key=%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{pp|0.4/10 to 0.65/10 for 6;0.75/10 to 1.25/10 for 6;1.4/10;1.55/10;1.7/10;1.9/10;2.1/10;2.3/10|key=%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}
|icon2        = Goes Where He Pleases.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Passive:}} Periodically, '''Dr. Mundo''' gains immunity to the next hostile {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect to affect him. Upon resisting one, '''Dr. Mundo''' pays a {{as|health cost}} equal to {{as|4% of his '''current''' health}} and propels a canister that lands 525 units in the general direction of the immobilization source, remaining on the ground for 7 seconds.
|description3 = '''Dr. Mundo''' can move near the canister to consume it, {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for {{as|4% of his '''maximum''' health}} and reducing the {{sti|cooldown}} of ''Goes Where He Pleases'' by 15 seconds. Enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can move near it to destroy it.
|description4 = ''Goes Where He Pleases' '' cooldown resets upon [[respawn|respawning]].
|static       = {{pp|60 to 15 for 6|1;3 to 15 for 5|formula=60 at level 1, then -9 every 3 levels, starting at level 3 and capped at level 15}}
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|projectile   = false
|notes        = 
* Upon being triggered by a hostile {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect, ''Goes Where He Pleases'' will also grant '''Dr. Mundo''' immunity to additional immobilizing effects from the same {{tip|cast instance}}.
** Abilities where non-immobilizing effects and damage are nested into immobilizing ones will have them also prevented. Non-immobilizing effects and damage applied separately (the vast majority of cases) are not prevented.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} and {{ai|Black Shield|Morgana}} take priority over ''Goes Where He Pleases''.
* The canister, whether in flight and on the ground, will transition in and out of {{cai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser|Death Realm}} alongside ''Dr. Mundo''.{{bug|2}}
* The canister cannot be interacted with while {{tip|untargetable}}.
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Dr. Mundo_Original_Move_2.ogg}} ''"Mundo goes where he pleases!"''
}}

E.name: Blunt Force Trauma
E.title: Template:Data Dr. Mundo/Blunt Force Trauma
E.wikitext:
<!-- Damage values are defined as parameters.
-->{{#vardefine:b1|5}}<!-- Generic/Normal rank 1 base damage
-->{{#vardefine:b5|45}}<!-- Generic/Normal rank 5 base damage
-->{{#vardefine:hp|5}}<!-- Generic/Normal bonus health ratio as a PERCENTAGE
-->{{#vardefine:mod|1.4}}<!-- Maximum damage increase as a DECIMAL
-->{{#vardefine:mnn|1.4}}<!--Minion modifier as a DECIMAL
-->{{#vardefine:mst|1.4}}<!-- Monster modifier as a DECIMAL
-->{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Blunt Force Trauma|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Dr. Mundo
|skill        = E
|icon         = false
|blurbicon    = Blunt Force Trauma.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Dr. Mundo}} gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} based on his {{as|'''maximum''' health}}.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo's''' next basic attack deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, increased based on {{as|his '''missing''' health}}. If the target dies, their corpse is sent flying away in a line, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies it passes through.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{as|{{ap|2 to 3.2}}% '''maximum''' health}}}}
|icon2        = Blunt Force Trauma.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|50 '''bonus''' range}}, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, increased by {{pp|key=%|key1=%|type='''Dr. Mundo's missing''' health|0 to {{#expr:{{#var:mod}}*100-100}} for 11|0 to 70|formula=0.57% per missing health %, up to a cap of 70%.|color=health}}. If the target dies or is a small monster, they are sent flying away in a line, though not through terrain, causing all enemies they pass through to take {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} plus ''Blunt Force Trauma's'' minimum '''bonus''' damage.
|leveling2    = {{st|Minimum Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}} to {{#var:b5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:hp}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*{{#var:mod}} to {{#var:b5}}*{{#var:mod}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:hp}}*{{#var:mod}}}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
|description3 = ''Blunt Force Trauma'' as well as the triggering {{as|attack's damage}} is increased to {{#expr:{{#var:mnn}}*100}}% against {{tip|minions}} and {{#expr:{{#var:mst}}*100}}% against {{tip|monsters}}.
|leveling3    = {{st|Minimum Minion Physical Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*{{#var:mnn}} to {{#var:b5}}*{{#var:mnn}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:hp}}*{{#var:mnn}}}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Minion Physical Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*{{#var:mod}}*{{#var:mnn}} to {{#var:b5}}*{{#var:mod}}*{{#var:mnn}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:hp}}*{{#var:mod}}*{{#var:mnn}}}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Monster Physical Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*{{#var:mst}} to {{#var:b5}}*{{#var:mst}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:hp}}*{{#var:mst}}}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Monster Physical Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*{{#var:mod}}*{{#var:mst}} to {{#var:b5}}*{{#var:mod}}*{{#var:mst}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:hp}}*{{#var:mod}}*{{#var:mst}}}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
|description4 = ''Blunt Force Trauma {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Dr. Mundo's''' basic attack timer.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|9 to 6}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = {{as|{{ap|10 to 70}}|health}}
|costtype     = {{as|Health}}
|cast time    = none
|targeting    = Auto
|range        = {{tt|650|Corpse push distance}}
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|155|Corpse size}}
|collision radius=
|affects      = 
|damagetype   = physical
|spellshield  = false
|spelleffects = special
|parry        = true
|notes        = 
* ''Blunt Force Trauma's'' damage is treated as {{tip|basic damage}} but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}, while the target's body being shoved deals {{tip|area damage}} to enemies it passes through.
** The {{tip|basic attack}} is also considered a part of ''Blunt Force Trauma'' and treated as both {{tip|basic damage}} and {{tip|spell damage}}.<!--or proc damage, PFT-->
* ''Blunt Force Trauma's'' attack works against {{tip|structures}}, consuming the buff and dealing its full damage.
* ''Blunt Force Trauma'' cannot knock back {{tip|wards}}, {{tip|structures}}, epic {{tip|monsters}}, {{cai|I|Illaoi|Tentacles}} and {{cai|W|Yorick}} it kills, nor champions that enter a {{tip|zombie state}} upon dying.
** {{cai|I|Zyra|Plants}} and {{cai|W|Kalista}} can be flung.
* Targets flung away are rendered {{tip|untargetable}} in the process.
* The damage of the enemy's corpse colliding with enemies does not benefit from ''Blunt Force Trauma's'' attack {{tip|critical strike|critically striking}}.
}}
